jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote

**Type:** Internship

**Product:** SaaS Platforms

**About the role:** We're looking for a sharp, curious, and proactive Product Intern who can help us build and ship SaaS products faster. We're a lean team, so you'll be involved in actual product development. You'll work closely with the Product Manager, designers, and developers to understand how our products work, solve problems and keep things moving.

**What you will work on:** We are building a Lead Tracking SaaS CRM platform which help businesses to manage their sales process, from capturing leads to converting them into customers. The platform brings together leads from various sources, assign leads to agents, manage follow-ups & track sales activities. You'll be involved in building and improving features across the platform, working through real product problems. We don't expect you to know everything from day one. We'll guide you, but you'll need to make the effort to understand the product, ask the right questions, and figure things out independently. If you're someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every task, this role may not be for you.

**What you'll own:**

* **Product understanding:** Learn how our products work, including their features, workflows, business logic, and dependencies.
* **Research & problem-solving:** Research competitors, explore solutions, question existing approaches, and suggest improvements.
